subject: Post-call confirmation: pilot success metrics, scope & access plan
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Maya Thornton <maya@evershore.com>, Eric Lin <eric.lin@evershore.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: technical alignment & pilot success criteria

Thanks for the time today — quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps so we can get the pilot scoped and scheduled.

Key pain points you shared:
- Unpredictable per-request cost and spikes during peak hours (billing surprises).
- Latency variability on inference for clinical summarization use case (p95 often > 800ms).
- Data residency and PHI handling requirements — need HIPAA-ready controls and audit logs.

Primary goals for a 4-week pilot:
1) Reduce per-inference unit cost by ~40% through batching and quantization while keeping output quality within your acceptance criteria.
2) Achieve p95 latency < 200ms for the 1–2k token clinical summarization path under expected traffic (20 reqs/s burst).
3) Validate Private/VPC deployment workflow for PHI and confirm audit log delivery and KMS integration.

Proposed pilot scope (what we will deliver):
- Dedicated pilot capacity (4 GPU nodes) configured with model variant we discussed (Redwood-optimized LlamaX-13B quantized).
- Prompt set: 200 representative clinical notes + 50 edge-case prompts (we'll share template).
- Eval metrics: semantic similarity (ROUGE+embedding distance), hallucination rate (manual sampling with checklists), latency (p50/p95), and cost per 1k tokens.
- Owners: Karthik (RDS lead & AM), Laura Bennett (eval lead), Your SRE contact for network/VPC access.

Immediate access/setup asks (what we need from Evershore this week):
- SRE point-of-contact + public IPs for allowlist (or VPN details).
- A sample of 50 de-identified notes for prompt tuning (S3 link or secure upload).
- Confirmation whether SOC 2 Type II evidence is sufficient or if you need on-prem packaging.

Attachments: evershore-pilot-charter-v1.pdf (charter + timeline), evershore-access-checklist.xlsx (access steps).

Proposed kickoff: week of Feb 8 — suggest Tue, Feb 9 10:00 AM PT for a 30-min go/no-go and access handoff.

Next steps:
- Maya: confirm SRE contact and preferred kickoff date.
- Evershore: share sample data link and any compliance docs requirements.
- We: share pilot acceptance criteria and one-page cost estimate (attached).

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

--
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com | (415) 555-0124
Redwood Inference

From: Maya Thornton <maya@evershore.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Eric Lin <eric.lin@evershore.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Feb 2027 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: technical alignment & pilot success criteria

Thanks for the clear recap, Karthik — exactly what we needed. Quick confirmations and a couple of clarifications: 

- SRE contact: that will be me for now; I'll loop in our infra lead (Victor Park) once we lock dates. I'll send Victor's contact by EOD.
- Data: we can provide a de-identified S3 bucket with 50 notes by Thursday. We need a short ingestion checklist (format, redaction expectations) so we don't delay.
- SOC2: SOC 2 Type II is sufficient for our procurement team, but for production we will require VPC/private hosting. For the pilot, the VPC option would be ideal to validate the workflow.
- Timeline: Feb 9 kickoff works for us; we'd prefer Feb 9 11:00 AM PT if that still fits your team.

One ask on quality: our clinicians will review outputs and may flag hallucinations aggressively. Can we agree on an initial sampling plan (10% manual review of outputs) and a process to triage issues?

I'll also start the PO/contract discussion with procurement — can you share a one-page pilot SOW and our expected deliverables?

Best,
Maya
Head of Data Products, Evershore Health
maya@evershore.com | +1 650-555-9987
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Feb 2027 12:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: technical alignment & pilot success criteria

Appreciate the quick reply, Maya — all sounds good and we can accommodate the asks. A few clarifications: 

- Ingestion checklist: attaching evershore-access-checklist.xlsx — includes S3 path format, required file schemas, and redaction guidance. If anything looks off, ping me and we'll adjust.
- VPC option: we'll provision a Private trial namespace in your VPC for the pilot. We'll need Victor or your infra team to validate firewall rules and provide KMS ARN for key wrapping.
- Sampling plan: agreed. Laura will lead the eval and we'll do 10% manual review on week 2 and week 4 with a standardized issue template.
- Pilot SOW: attached in the charter PDF (evershore-pilot-charter-v1.pdf). The one-page SOW / PO-friendly summary is on page 2.

Proposed kickoff: Feb 9, 11:00 AM PT — I'll send a calendar invite and include a short agenda (access handoff, SRE contacts, immediate tests).

Let me know Victor's contact when ready. We'll also share the short cost estimate (pilot-cost-estimate-v1.xlsx) and a link to the HubSpot deal for your procurement reference.

Thanks — Karthik

Subject: Internal: Evershore pilot — resource and config notes

Karthik / Ben — quick internal note before kickoff. Planning to lead the eval and keep the manual review cadence. A few items I need confirmed so we can prepare the environment: 

- GPU profile: confirm we are scheduling 4x A10G (or equivalent). That aligns with our latency estimates for the quantized 13B variant.
- Quantization policy: I'll run 8-bit PTQ by default; if downstream quality drops we'll switch to mixed 16/8 for the long-tail. Need Ben to confirm policy for fallback.
- Data handling: we'll ensure no raw PHI is stored in the hosted logs — audit logs will be pushed to their KMS-backed S3 as specified.

I'll prepare the eval checklist and the manual review template (will attach to the kickoff invite).
